summary: Tested Phase B GST Reports module (10 reports + Excel/PDF exports + admin-only access) end-to-end. Backend pytest: 37/38 passed (97%). Frontend: 100% (Reports tab renders, 10 options in select, switching report types auto-loads data, Excel + PDF downloads work, totals row highlighted blue, Indian number formatting verified, no horizontal overflow at 1920/1366/375). Found 1 real backend bug: HSN Summary produces duplicate rows for same (hsn, unit, gst_rate) tuple because dict grouping key is built from raw li.get('gst_rate', 0) value — when DB stores some line items with gst_rate as int 5 and others as float 5.0, the f-string produces different keys ('271119|Cylinder|5' vs '271119|Cylinder|5.0'), so rows fail to merge even though final output displays both as 5.0. Verified live: 2 separate rows for HSN 271119 Cylinder 5.0 GST appearing instead of 1 merged row. All other 9 reports + 20 export endpoints + admin-only enforcement work correctly. Plant warehouse exclusion in warehouse_wise verified. Payment modes correctly uppercased. Tax summary sorted asc by rate. Item-wise sorted desc by total_value. Customer-wise sorted desc by grand_total. GST report B2B/B2C separated with counts. Cancelled returns only cancelled invoices with lost_value. Invalid report_type returns 400 with valid keys in detail. Date range filter works. Non-admin (jullang) gets 403 on all 4 report routes.

minor.issue: Duplicate rows for same (HSN, unit, gst_rate) — grouping key uses raw li.get('gst_rate') which is sometimes int and sometimes float in DB, so 5 and 5.0 produce different dict keys. Fix: build key with `float(li.get('gst_rate') or 0)` (mirror what is already used for the row value). Live evidence: HSN 271119 Cylinder 5.0% appears twice with 6 qty / 8190.48 taxable AND 2 qty / 2000 taxable instead of being merged into 8 qty / 10190.48.

action_items: Fix HSN Summary grouping bug in /app/backend/routes/gst_reports.py (_build_hsn_summary): change `key = f"{hsn}|{unit}|{li.get('gst_rate', 0)}"` to `key = f"{hsn}|{unit}|{float(li.get('gst_rate') or 0)}"` so int/float DB values normalize to a single key.

rca of the issue: HSN Summary duplicate row bug RCA — In _build_hsn_summary (line 207), the dict key is constructed as f'{hsn}|{unit}|{li.get("gst_rate", 0)}'. When invoice line items are stored with gst_rate as int (e.g. 5) vs float (e.g. 5.0) — which happens because different code paths in invoice generation use different types — the f-string produces 2 distinct strings '271119|Cylinder|5' and '271119|Cylinder|5.0'. setdefault therefore creates 2 separate row dicts, both later rendered with gst_rate normalized to 5.0 via float() — so they LOOK identical to the user but are not aggregated. Reproduction: GET /api/gst/reports/hsn_summary as admin → rows[1] and rows[2] both have hsn='271119', unit='Cylinder', gst_rate=5.0 but different qty/value. Mitigation: in _build_hsn_summary change the key to f'{hsn}|{unit}|{float(li.get("gst_rate") or 0)}'. Same defensive normalization is already used in _build_tax_summary (line 421) — apply the same pattern here.
